success.alarm: At least 85% button travel, then below 20%, hand contact and release dwell
success.drawer: Below 2 mm open and 10 mm/s for the dwell
success.laptop: Below 5 degrees and 0.15 rad/s, at least 4 degrees of contact-driven progress, release dwell
success.globe: Within 3 degrees of target and 0.07 rad/s for the release dwell
success.full_sequence: All four task verifications in order, no fall, with drawer/laptop/globe still within terminal position and speed tolerances.

protocol.selection: Highest full-sequence development completions; then task completions, stations reached, fewer falls, shorter episode. Earliest checkpoint wins exact ties.
protocol.scope: Command-level locomotion and task-profile post-training. Native Unitree gait, classical leg servos and arm IK are fixed. State observations, simulation only.
protocol.uncertainty: Report raw paired scenario outcomes and Wilson intervals; four fresh test seeds are a pilot, not evidence of broad robotics generalization.
protocol.labels: Walking imitates a fixed waypoint policy. Task labels are chosen only from actual MuJoCo training trials. No hidden mass, friction, seed, teacher labels or evaluation outcomes enter the model observation.
